title: Lys's disapproval line for the second peaceful-wolf kill ('Both of them, now. Two things that would have let you walk on by, and you didn't let either.') did not fire when the kill happened; it fired one full turn later, attached to an unrelated 'take wild herbs' pickup, making an innocuous action look like the cause of her anger.
